import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('a call with a callback', () => {
  it('spans lines', () => {
    const seen: number[] = [];
    [1, 2, 3].forEach((value) => {
      seen.push(value);
    });
    expect(seen).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);
    [4, 5].forEach((value) => seen.push(value));
    [6].forEach((value) => {
      seen.push(value);
    });
    [7].forEach((value) => {
      seen.push(value);
    }); expect(seen).toHaveLength(7);
  });
});
